content: Choreography saga for e-commerce order/payment on Kafka is the standard pattern (microservices.io saga pattern; multiple 2024-2026 implementations): order service persists PENDING order then publishes order.created; payment consumes, authorizes, emits payment.completed/success; order consumes it and transitions status via a state machine (PENDING -> CONFIRMED/CANCELLED, terminal states immutable). Consumers must be idempotent keyed on event/order ID (dedup table, natural upsert, or status-field guard) because Kafka is at-least-once and rebalances redeliver uncommitted messages. One consumer group per service so every service gets its own copy of each topic; partition key by orderId for per-order ordering; commit-after-process ordering.
